name: NerfTrack v1.1.7
body:
## GPT-6 API pricing

Added offline API-equivalent rates per 1M tokens:

- GPT-6 Sol: $2.00 input, $0.20 cached input, $10.00 output.
- GPT-6 Luna: $0.10 input, $0.01 cached input, $0.50 output.

Added the documented GPT-6 long-context and Fast-mode rates. Existing usage is repriced under the updated pricing rule. Details: [calculation notes](https://github.com/NerfTrack/NerfTrack/blob/v1.1.7/docs/CALCULATION.md).

## Validation

Prettier, ESLint, frontend typecheck, 59 frontend tests, Rust formatting, Clippy across all targets and features, 110 Rust tests, release build, installation, ad-hoc signing, and installed-bundle verification passed.

name: NerfTrack v1.1.0
body:
## NerfTrack v1.1.0

This release includes performance, build-size, and efficiency improvements:

- Reduced the release executable and application bundle size by approximately 28% through symbol stripping and single-unit release code generation.
- Improved release-build and packaging efficiency while preserving existing runtime behavior and functionality.
- No changes to the UI, APIs, data formats, workflows, dataset, or supported features.

Validation included frontend tests, Rust tests, formatting, lint, typecheck, production builds, Tauri packaging, installation, signing, and bundle verification.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ayaan-Lashari/NerfTrack/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

name: NerfTrack v1.0.0
body:
First public-ready, non-beta NerfTrack release, with a stable experience for general use.

- Removed the gray chart fallback during manual scrubbing so the graph retains its normal positive or negative color.
- Restored the displayed dollar and percentage difference when comparison endpoints are immature, same-window, or otherwise unavailable to the guarded comparison helper.
- Kept the adaptive chart axis, mature comparison calculations, and all other graph behavior unchanged.

Validated with frontend and Rust tests, typecheck, lint, formatting, production/Tauri builds, installation, ad-hoc signing, installed bundle verification, and all four release artifact jobs.

name: NerfTrack 0.6.2
body:
## Highlights

- Adaptive zero-based USD chart axis with exact equal tick spacing and tens-based steps targeting 5–7 intervals.
- Manual scrub comparisons now require finite positive stabilized estimates, finalized non-heartbeat mature endpoints, high/medium confidence, at least 10 percentage points of coverage, ordered timestamps, distinct weekly epochs, and conservative interpolation metadata.
- Invalid same-window comparisons remain neutral and show “Comparison unavailable · estimator calibration”; incomplete or low-confidence endpoints show “Comparison unavailable · endpoints need mature history”.
- Valid mature cross-window signed dollar and percentage comparisons remain available.
- Fast-mode accounting, pricing, raw log ingestion, database rows, historical data, and backend range statistics are unchanged.

## Validation

- npm test: 41 tests passed
- npm run typecheck: passed
- npm run lint: passed
- cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml: 96 tests passed
- npm run build: passed
- Release workflow: four architecture builds, artifact checks, and macOS signature checks passed

name: NerfTrack v0.6.1
body:
## What's new

- Added explicit Codex Fast-mode accounting from `thread_settings_applied` rollout events.
- Recognizes `priority` and `fast` as Fast, `default` as Standard, and leaves missing or unrecognized tiers unclassified.
- Applies exact Fast credit multipliers: 2.0× for GPT-5.4 and 2.5× for GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6, and explicitly marked future models.
- Corrects historical token costs, estimates, and graph points using explicit rollout tier evidence.
- Handles tier changes within a rollout chronologically and preserves historical records without explicit tier evidence.
- Historical rebuilding is deterministic and transactional; existing Standard-mode estimates remain unchanged.

## Verification

- Rust tests: 96 passed
- Frontend tests: 20 passed
- Release workflow: all macOS and Windows architecture builds passed
- Release assets: macOS ARM64, macOS Intel, Windows x64, and Windows ARM64

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ayaan-Lashari/NerfTrack/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

name: NerfTrack v0.6.0
body:
## Highlights

- Added automatic pricing refresh from models.dev when NerfTrack opens.
- Supports pricing data for all models available through models.dev, not only OpenAI models.
- Historical usage, graphs, estimates, and calculations are repriced using the current catalog.
- Preserved manual pricing overrides for custom or unsupported models.
- Stores pricing snapshots and uses cached or embedded fallback pricing when models.dev is unavailable.

## Downloads

This release includes macOS ARM64, macOS Intel, Windows x64, and Windows ARM64 builds.
